## `@sutra/ui/format`

@sutra/ui/format: number, duration, date and relative-time formatters and the date helpers behind them (subpath only). Deliberately NOT part of the root `@sutra/ui`: names like `toMs`, `formatCompact` and `formatDuration` are generic enough to collide with an app's own, so they are imported from here on purpose. (`pad2` stays internal: no public signature needs it.) `formatBytes`, `splitDuration` and `base32Decode` are not here: the root and their components' modules have their own versions (`FileUpload`, `Countdown`, `TOTP`). An explicit list (no `export *`): test/api-surface.test.ts keeps every name off the root, and scripts/gen-index.mjs lists this entry in SUBPATH_ONLY so the root can never include it.

Icon, FeaturedIcon and the full Remix Icon set.

## `@sutra/ui/tokens`

@sutra/ui/tokens: design tokens, class helpers, the tone/status/accent/direction vocabulary, spring maths and the generic hooks. Only what the docs present to consumers is public here. The rest of src/lib and src/hooks (clamp, pad2, hashString, useLatestRef, useIsoLayoutEffect, useMountedRef, errorMessage, the gesture/flip/morph/deck maths ...) is internal: import it by relative path inside the package. The formatting and date helpers are public from the subpath-only @sutra/ui/format, never from here or the root. To make one public, document it (README, a note, a skill) and list it here. test/api-surface.test.ts guards this list (names in INTERNAL_NAMES must stay out of every entry).
